mentions.name: Serpentine
mentions.description: Online multiplayer Boggle game originally built in 2008 that still has daily players 17 years later; it was recently rewritten from scratch in modern technologies (with AI assistance to finish the rewrite) and relaunched.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built on online multiplayer boggle game back in 2008 that somehow drew a lot of users, many of whom still play every day after 17 years. About a year ago I started a rewrite from scratch in more modern technologies but stalled out after getting to about 80% of the way there. A few months ago Claude enabled me to finish the remaining 20% and was able to relaunch mostly successfully!
